name: introspection-example-pap-travel
description: Flight Sector, a Personal Agent Protocol demo: Sam's assistant Atlas rebooks a delayed flight by talking to Flight Sector's agent, with every request on the wire beside the conversation.

scripts.dev: portless alias atlas 3500 --force && portless alias pap.flightsector 3500 --force && NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=${NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS:-$HOME/.portless/ca.pem} next dev --turbopack --port 3500
